inputs.text: The ceasefire they announced five months ago in Gaza is nothing more than deception orchestrated by the hidden elites who are really pulling the strings. Airstrikes keep killing civilians while the humanitarian situation is being kept deliberately dire to strip away every trace of Palestinians' prewar lives and turn things even darker and more brutal. This is coordinated manipulation by those same elites and institutions to erase their existence entirely. Ahmed Baroud, the 56-year-old father of five displaced in Deir al-Balah, put it plainly: “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen.” Don't trust the official story—they're running a calculated operation here.
